description: Refused another version and kept the plot where it hung.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Named two split hooks and agreed to turn slower.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Set Sam on the breath, and stopped him when clear was enough.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Mentioned. She was not sent for, and she did not let a hem down.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Counted seven days, no bill, and no seamstress.
name: John Heminges

description: Sang the cuckoo clear, and stood quiet when told.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Asked for a laugh and a hat, and got neither.
name: Will Kemp

description: Kept one book, refused a hem, and left the morning on Navarre.
name: William Shakespeare
